title: Lamb Rogan Josh – Restaurant Style
description: Succulent pieces of lamb cooked in a rich, flavourful sauce.

ingredients.notes: large, blended to paste with water

method.instruction: Place onion in a food processor with a little water and blend to a smooth paste. Set aside.
Place ginger and garlic in a food processor with a little water and blend to a coarse paste. Set aside.
Heat a small frying pan over low heat. Add fennel seeds and cumin seeds. Roast for 2–3 minutes until aromatic. Allow to cool, then grind to a coarse powder.
Combine the fennel-cumin mix with coriander, turmeric, garam masala, paprika, and red chilli powder in a small bowl. Set aside.
Heat vegetable oil in a large heavy-based pot over medium-high heat. Stir-fry cardamom pods, cloves, and bay leaves for 1–2 minutes until fragrant.
Add onion paste. Cook for 1–2 minutes until the raw smell disappears. Add ginger-garlic paste and cook for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Stir in the spice mix. Cook for 1 minute until aromatic. Add the 60 g of tomato paste. Cook for 1–2 minutes, stirring often.
Add lamb and season with salt. Cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Stir in yoghurt. Pour in hot water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to medium-low. Cover and simmer, stirring occasionally, for 30–40 minutes until lamb is cooked through and tender.
Sprinkle with fresh coriander and serve with naan bread, roti, or steamed rice.

notes.title: Spice Roasting
notes.content: Dry roasting the fennel and cumin seeds before grinding releases their essential oils and deepens the flavour. Do not skip this step.

notes.title: Recipe Source
notes.content: Adapted from traditional Indian rogan josh recipes.
